int_name: N BROAD ST & W WESTMORELAND ST

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with essential pedestrian infrastructure including marked zebra crosswalks, curb ramps, and dedicated pedestrian signals. However, the wide roadway design and lack of physical medians or curb extensions result in significant exposure for pedestrians crossing the street.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Exposure
hazards.description: The lack of a median refuge or curb extensions increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Construction Zone Encroachment
hazards.description: Traffic cones and barriers on the right side of the street may create minor navigation challenges or driver distraction.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway beyond the intersection

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with high-visibility zebra crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and curb ramps, providing a basic level of safety. However, the wide multi-lane roadway creates a significant crossing distance that increases pedestrian exposure to traffic without the protection of a median refuge.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic in a single stage, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main intersection

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian refuge
hazards.description: There is no median or island to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians who cannot complete the crossing in one signal cycle.
